D

DEFAULT_MAX_BASIC_RETRIES - Static variable in class com.senzing.sdk.core.auto.SzAutoCoreEnvironment
The default number of times this class will perform a basic retry when an SzRetryableException occurs.
destroy() - Method in class com.senzing.sdk.core.auto.SzAutoCoreEnvironment
Overridden to ensure that if the configuration refresh is proactive that the background thread that handles periodic refresh is shutdown before destroying the environment.
DISABLED - Enum constant in enum class com.senzing.sdk.core.auto.SzAutoCoreEnvironment.RefreshMode
The configuration will never be automatically refreshed.
DISABLED_CONCURRENCY - Static variable in class com.senzing.sdk.core.auto.SzAutoCoreEnvironment
A null Integer reference that can be used with SzAutoCoreEnvironment.AbstractBuilder.concurrency(Integer) to disable the isolated concurrency thread pool and enable execution in the calling thread.
DISABLED_CONFIG_REFRESH - Static variable in class com.senzing.sdk.core.auto.SzAutoCoreEnvironment
A null Duration reference that can be used with SzAutoCoreEnvironment.AbstractBuilder.configRefreshPeriod(Duration) to disable configuration refresh and automatic retry of failed methods that are annotated with SzConfigRetryable.
doExecute(Callable<T>) - Method in class com.senzing.sdk.core.auto.SzAutoCoreEnvironment
Overridden to implement the use of an internal ExecutorService if this instance has been configured with a positive concurrency that provides for an execution thread pool.

E

ensureConfigCurrent() - Method in class com.senzing.sdk.core.auto.SzAutoCoreEnvironment
Protected method to ensure the active configuration ID is the same as the default configuration ID.
execute(Callable<T>) - Method in class com.senzing.sdk.core.auto.SzAutoCoreEnvironment
Overridden to implement retry logic if SzAutoCoreEnvironment.getConfigRefreshMode() is not SzAutoCoreEnvironment.RefreshMode.DISABLED and an SzException is encountered on a Senzing Core SDK method that is annotated with SzConfigRetryable.
executeWithBasicRetry(Callable<T>) - Method in class com.senzing.sdk.core.auto.SzAutoCoreEnvironment
Calls the super class SzAutoCoreEnvironment.execute(Callable) implementation at least once and then repeatedly if necessary until either the call succeeds, fails with an exception other than SzRetryableException or the configured maximum number of retry attempts has been reached.

P

PROACTIVE - Enum constant in enum class com.senzing.sdk.core.auto.SzAutoCoreEnvironment.RefreshMode
The configuration will be refreshed in the background periodically using a specified Duration as the refresh period.

R

REACTIVE - Enum constant in enum class com.senzing.sdk.core.auto.SzAutoCoreEnvironment.RefreshMode
The configuration will be refreshed on-demand in response to an exception being thrown by a method annotated with SzConfigRetryable.
REACTIVE_CONFIG_REFRESH - Static variable in class com.senzing.sdk.core.auto.SzAutoCoreEnvironment
A zero (0) Duration instance that can be used with SzAutoCoreEnvironment.AbstractBuilder.configRefreshPeriod(Duration) to enable Reactive configuration refresh so that configuration refresh and automatic retry are performed on demand when a method annotated with SzConfigRetryable fails with an SzException.
RECOMMENDED_CONCURRENCY - Static variable in class com.senzing.sdk.core.auto.SzAutoCoreEnvironment
A zero (0) Integer instance that can be used with SzAutoCoreEnvironment.AbstractBuilder.concurrency(Integer) to indicate that the concurrency should be set to Runtime.availableProcessors().
